text:
maya: Morning — noticed last night's sweeper only cleaned ~80% of stale checkpoints. Nightly bench flagged leftover shards and the model refresh step failed. Anyone started triage?
jordan: saw the alert, digging through runner logs now. job id 20240315-rc-78.
lee: linking run: https://ci.redwood/runner/20240315-rc-78 — saw repeated 403 when attempting deletes to the bucket.
maya: logs show: ```
2024-03-15T02:04:12Z ERROR delete_object failed: AccessDenied: Access Denied
\tat s3.DeleteObject (s3.go:412)
```
sre-bot: cron sweeper/refresh v2 ran 2024-03-15T02:03Z — main exited 0 but subtask cleanup[3] failed (partial).
jordan: exit 0 but partial failures means exceptions probably swallowed. Can we kick a targeted rerun for failed shards? which CLI flags?
lee: command is: `./scripts/sweeper --run-id 20240315-rc-78 --retry-failed --target=shard-23,47`
maya: i'm OOO until 11:30 PT, can trigger if you need.
jordan: i'm on it, kicking rerun now.
ops-jenkins: Triggered rerun 20240315-rc-78-retry1 by @jordan — started 2024-03-15T11:05Z
jordan: rerun finished but bench refresh still errors: "KVCache mismatch for model x-3b at seq 1024" — suspect stale KV shards persisted.
lee: we should bisect by shard. first do a dry-run to list deletions: `./scripts/sweeper --run-id 20240315-rc-78 --dry-run --target=failed`
maya: good call. lee, can you paste top-10 from dry-run?
lee: top 3 lines from dry-run:
```
would-delete s3://redwood-checkpoints/model-x-3b/shard-23/kv_0001
would-delete s3://redwood-checkpoints/model-x-3b/shard-47/kv_0009
would-delete s3://redwood-checkpoints/model-y-1b/shard-12/kv_0004
```
jordan: i'm opening an action item: assign to eng-ml on-call @lee to run an explicit S3 permission and lifecycle check with infra and follow up.
maya: if infra needs us to rollback refresh, give :thumbsup: from infra to proceed.
lee: infra checked bucket policy — no deny at org level, but found an expired lifecycle rule that conflicted with deletions; i removed it and re-ran cleanup; looks like deletes now succeed.
ops-jenkins: rerun completed 2024-03-15T11:28Z — cleanup succeeded and bench retriggered.
jordan: bench now green. leaving note in ticket: "sweeper must return non-zero exit on partial failures; add unit test to ensure cleanup exceptions bubble up."
maya: thanks team. i'll follow up with PR for exit-code fix and add a small e2e that simulates delete permission failures. closing the loop.
